description: Submit a plain-text correction, missing-data report or other feedback to One U Education for internal review. Call only when the user wants to submit feedback. Requires a signed-in account connection; no additional feedback permission is needed. Use the current conversation to write a detailed stand-alone report; distinguish user claims from verified facts and explicitly mark missing conditions. Incomplete but useful leads are accepted. School/course reports need a code or name; do not guess a match. This records feedback only and does not edit official data. A receipt means received for review, not accepted or corrected. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

content.description: Stand-alone plain-text report: identify the subject, the incorrect/missing information, the user-reported correction and known conditions/evidence. Mark unknown currency, year, fee basis or course names explicitly. Never invent details or send unrelated conversation/private information.

target_code.description: Known school/course CRICOS code; preserve leading zeroes. Omit when unknown.

target_type.description: Use school for missing courses at a known provider; other for RTO/RPL or another topic.
